title: Chiang Mai Enduro Riders Tracks
subtitle: Beginner-friendly enduro GPX routes around Chiang Mai
restricted: Please ride these community tracks instead of Doi Suthep or Hang Dong, which are restricted areas.
contribute: Found a change on a track? Open the track and use "Send it to us".

sections.title: Easy Enduro
sections.intro: Easy GPS tracks for beginners. All are outside national parks and not restricted, except the Mae Khanin river loop, which is closed during smoke season.

sections.title: Adventure
sections.intro: Longer rides on small village roads, mostly concrete with some dirt, through remote hill-tribe villages. Plan a full day.
